correctness.summary: All published coordinates are divisible by 3, so the normalized table is an integer homothetic realization. Two normalized vertex-difference minors are -8 and 1325, whose gcd is 1, proving that the difference lattice is all of Z^3. Hence every affine map sending all normalized vertices to integer points has an integer linear part. The vertex differences (0,200,0) and (200,0,0) force width at least 200 for every integer covector with a nonzero y- or x-component, while the vertical width is 156. Independent rows of an invertible integer matrix therefore yield sorted coordinate spans at least (156,200,200), attained by the normalized realization. Exact arithmetic verification was executed successfully.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Mizhaev's 2026 v1 provides the integer realization and explicitly states that its certificate does not establish coordinate minimality or optimal aspect ratios. It does not discuss the common factor 3, saturation of the normalized difference lattice, lattice width, or affine-integral box optimality. Exact-title and synonymous searches using integer coordinates, minimal coordinates, lattice width, integral affine, bounding box, and equivelar octahedron found no matching statement; neither did searches of the current SCOPE archive by source ID, author, object, and terminology. Hougardy--Lutz--Zelke concerns different genus-3 triangulations. Mizhaev's 2020 precursor was identified, but its full text was not available for inspection, leaving residual historical risk.

value.summary: The result improves the published exact certificate by a factor of 3 in every coordinate scale and a factor of 27 in axis-aligned box-volume product, then proves the normalized certificate is sharp throughout its entire affine orbit under integrality. The exact span profile (156,200,200) and saturated lattice normalization are reusable invariants for integer-coordinate enumeration and computational models, while the broader global coordinate-minimality problem remains clearly separated.

limitations: Optimality is restricted to affine images of the displayed realization whose vertices remain integral.
Global coordinate minimality among all realizations of the same combinatorial map is not proved.
No optimal Euclidean aspect-ratio claim is made for arbitrary non-affine deformations.
The full text of Mizhaev's 2020 precursor was unavailable for inspection.
The motivating 2026 preprint is very recent, so later revisions or unindexed parallel observations may overlap.
Independent audit has not been performed.
